findings.text: Provides a global memory pressure service that attempts to free a caller requested page count using movable high user reclaim with unmapping plus writeback plus swapping allowed in a hibernation oriented mode and reports the amount actually freed.

Offers a batch rescue service that scans a folio collection and relocates members observed both evictable and still flagged unevictable back to normal reclaim handling while tolerating concurrent loss of reclaim tracking and maintaining rescued and scanned accounting.
Exposes per node proactive reclaim control by creating a device file during node registration and removing it during node unregistration tied to node device lifetime.
Supplies aggregated virtual memory event counters summed across online processors with stability of the processor set ensured by the public wrapper.
Provides folding of per processor access locality event deltas into zone level aggregates across all populated zones with per processor deltas cleared during collection.

Allows refresh of per processor zone statistic thresholds for every zone of a node that enables drift marking using a caller supplied calculator applied per zone and installed on every online processor.

Background per node reclamation thread that establishes allocator immunity and freezer support then alternates between sleeping and node balancing with original allocation order preserved for compaction wakeups and reduced reclaim order used for sleep decisions.
Boot time initializer that starts one background reclaimer for every memory equipped node and registers virtual memory tuning controls under a common prefix.
Node device write handler that forwards user supplied text to proactive reclaim for the node identified by the device instance and reports input length on success or an error otherwise.

Node balancing behaves as a priority driven reclaim session that is boost aware with suppressed writeback and swapping while boosted plus throttled task wakeups on forward progress plus failure accounting only for empty unboosted passes plus boost settlement and refault snapshotting at completion.

Sleep control uses a short timed wait followed by indefinite sleep with each stage gated by a balance predicate plus compaction wakeup and isolation cache reset when sleep appears possible plus relaxed thresholds while asleep and tightened thresholds while awake plus quick wake accounting.

Access locality statistics toggling behaves as a guarded switch where a write that changes enablement flips a global branch and either enables collection or disables collection and invalidates all zone and global counters while unchanged or failed writes leave state untouched.

Aging prefers generational aging when that mode is active and only continues to classic handling while generational switching remains in progress with classic rotation further requiring anonymous aging permission plus low inactive anonymous levels before rotating active anonymous across control groups.

Reclaim target scales with managed zones using the larger of each zone high watermark and a cluster sized floor with high order requests that achieve at least compaction gap progress treated as minimal order afterwards and success defined by scanned or newly reclaimed progress covering the target.

Presleep predicate wakes allocator waiters whenever present and treats hopeless nodes as sleepable to defer work to direct reclaim and treats balanced nodes as sleepable after clearing congestion while unbalanced nodes require continued reclaim.
Congestion relief clears node level plus control group level vector congestion plus node writeback indication together as a single transition to balanced state.
Reclaim activity marking applies uniformly to every managed zone up to a caller supplied ceiling with dedicated set and clear helpers delegating to a shared range updater.
Zone ceiling resolution preserves the previous ceiling when the shared request slot holds a sentinel meaning no explicit request and otherwise adopts the requested ceiling.
Event aggregation starts from zeroed output and accumulates every event counter from every online processor with the public entry adding processor set read protection around raw summation.
Invalidation clears both zone level and global locality counters with zone clearing covering per processor deltas and atomic aggregates for every event type across populated zones.
Toggling of locality statistics serializes through a dedicated mutex held across prior value sampling plus generic integer handling plus branch flip plus counter invalidation.
Decrement of per zone watermark boosts at the end of a boosted pass uses a snapshot taken at pass start and updates each boosted zone under its spin lock with interrupts saved.
Global event reads hold processor set read protection across summation to stabilize the online set during aggregation.

Unevictable batch scan holds at most one vector lock at a time with reacquisition across folios plus release after accounting plus lockless accounting when scans occurred without ever acquiring a vector lock.

Node descriptor observed to carry identity plus zone storage plus zone count plus allocator pressure waiting plus background sleep waiting plus shared order request plus shared ceiling request plus failure count plus throttling count plus flags.

Zone descriptor observed to carry lock plus flags plus managed state plus high watermark plus boost watermark plus drift mark plus per processor statistics with thresholds and locality deltas plus atomic locality aggregates.

Reclaim control observed to carry allocation mask plus order plus reclaim ceiling plus priority plus unmap plus writeback plus swap plus hibernation permissions plus cache trim mode flags plus scanned plus reclaimed plus target progress plus reclaim state.

Boosted reclaim suppresses writeback and swapping to avoid suboptimal input output plus caps priority escalation plus aborts promptly when a boosted pass makes no progress plus avoids persistent failure increments on empty boosted passes.

Sleep preparation wakes stalled allocators before sleeping to close races where throttling follows watermark checks or where exiting tasks balance zones before wake checks while hopeless nodes intentionally sleep to leave progress to direct reclaim.
Batch rescue clears reclaim tracking before vector locking and restores it afterwards while skipping folios that lost tracking concurrently to avoid moving folios undergoing control group migration.
Node reclaim priority constant equals 4.
Minimum slab ratio tuning defaults to 5.
Locality statistics enablement constant and default control value equal 1.
Virtual memory swappiness control appears under the name swappiness with mode 0644 and allowed interval 0 to 200.
On NUMA builds a zone reclaim mode control appears under the name zone_reclaim_mode with mode 0644 and lower bound 0.
Proactive reclaim parsing uses tag zero for parameterized swappiness with text swappiness=%d and tag one for maximum swappiness with text swappiness=max and tag two for termination.
Global zone plus node plus locality statistic arrays are sized by their respective item count macros and aligned to cache line for multiprocessing.
Virtual memory sysctls register under the prefix vm during background reclaimer initialization.
